en_US.title: Capsule Blackbox Audio 01
en_US.scanner: Capsule black-box event confirms the survival burn spent the ascent sleeve.
en_US.field_note: RECORDER BKX-CAP-01: crush-frame cracked at lower ring; ascent bus flooded; recovery ring no-lock; buoy repeats a dead ascent request.
en_US.terminal: BLACKBOX EVT 00:14:32: survival burn complete; ascent sleeve spent; recovery ring no-lock; buoy unreliable; frames dropped 12-19.
en_US.audio: Black box event. Survival burn complete. Ascent sleeve spent. Recovery ring no-lock. Frames twelve through nineteen missing.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The capsule blackbox proves the opening blocker. The descent survived by spending hardware that would have made ascent possible.
en_US.external_site: The first recovered blackbox makes survival a debt: the capsule bought one landing by burning the part meant to take it back.

en_US.title: P-63 Pump Room Work Order
en_US.scanner: Work order lists pump, seal, cut, pinger and gasket in pressure order.
en_US.field_note: Clipboard is soaked through the lower half. The line about cutting is still readable because somebody circled it twice.
en_US.terminal: WORK ORDER P-63: clear sump; patch cold seam; cut fused latch; deploy acoustic return line; print gasket only after pressure holds.
en_US.audio: Pump first. Seal second. If it sings, stop cutting.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The P-63 work order makes the first repair a colony procedure, not a tutorial overlay.
en_US.external_site: P-63 shows HECTON-8 at small scale: water in the room, one tool in hand, and a return route that has to be marked before it is trusted.

en_US.title: Quarantine Relay Fragment
en_US.scanner: Relay fragment approves extraction and denies clean release in the same packet.
en_US.field_note: Stamped twice: body recovered, person retained. Legal acceptance and release denial share one packet.
en_US.terminal: RELAY HOLD QRF-17: extraction accepted; release denied pending sample custody, air review and claimant dispute.
en_US.audio: Relay hold. Extraction accepted. Release denied: sample custody, air review, claimant dispute. You are dry, not free.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Quarantine relay fragments make partial exits bitter: extraction can save a body while keeping the witness under custody.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 endings can recover someone from the ocean without releasing them from the systems that sent them there.
